compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is part of a settings or preferences section where the user is asked to select their preferred units of measurement. The screen title is "Preferred units," and it asks the question, "Which units of measurement do you prefer?" 

There is a pop-up information box titled "Units information" that explains the two types of measurement units:
- Imperial: Includes units like pounds or feet.
- Metric: Includes units like kilograms or meters.

The pop-up has an "OK" button to close the information box. At the top right corner, there is a "NEXT" button, likely to proceed to the next step after making a selection.
